mapper.insert: insert into ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_article_remark( article_id, remark_content, remarked_id, remark_user, remarked_user, remark_type, is_read ) values( #{param.articleId}, #{param.remarkContent}, #{param.remarkedId}, #{param.remarkUser}, #{param.remarkedUser}, #{param.remarkType}, #{param.isRead} );
mapper.update:
update ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_article_remark
like_num = like_num + 1,
like_num = like_num - 1,
where remark_id = #{param.likedId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.select:
SELECT gar.remark_id, gar.article_id, gar.remark_content, gar.remarked_id, gar.remark_user, gar.audit_state, gar.remark_type, ga.article_title, ga.article_content, ga.article_cover FROM goods_article_remark gar LEFT JOIN goods_article_info ga ON gar.article_id = ga.article_id WHERE 1 = 1
and gar.remark_id=#{remarkId}

SELECT a.remark_id, a.article_id, a.remark_content, a.remarked_id, a.remark_user, c.user_nickname as remarkUserNickName, c.user_mobile as remarkUserPhone, a.remarked_user, d.user_nickname as remarkedUserNickName, d.user_mobile as remarkedUserPhone, a.audit_state, a.remark_type, a.create_time as postDate, b.article_cover, b.article_content FROM goods_article_remark a left join ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_article_info b on a.article_id = b.article_id left join ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_info c on a.remark_user=c.user_id left join ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_info d on a.remarked_user=d.user_id WHERE 1 = 1
and a.remark_user =#{param.remarkUser}
and a.audit_state = #{param.auditState}
and c.user_mobile like concat('%',#{param.remarkUserPhone},'%')
and d.user_mobile like concat('%',#{param.remarkedUserPhone},'%')
and c.user_nickname like concat('%',#{param.remarkUserNickName},'%')
and d.user_nickname like concat('%',#{param.remarkedUserNickName},'%')
order by a.remark_id desc

select a.remark_id,a.article_id,a.remark_content,a.remark_type,a.remarked_id,a.remark_user as userId,a.create_time as postDate, b.article_cover,b.article_content from ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_article_remark a left join ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_article_info b on a.article_id = b.article_id where a.audit_state=1 and a.remarked_user=#{param.userId} order by a.remark_id desc

select a.user_name as userName, b.user_avatar as userAvatar from ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_info a left join ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_info_detail b on a.user_id=b.user_id where a.user_id = #{userId}

select remark_id, remark_content, article_id, remarked_id, remark_user, remarked_user, STR_TO_DATE(create_time,'%Y-%m-%d') as remark_time, remark_type, like_num from ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_article_remark where article_id = #{param.articleId} and remarked_id = #{param.remarkedId} and remark_type = #{param.remarkType} and audit_state = 1
